product.description: Monoprice™Long Range Transmitter and Receiver With Bluetooth® Wireless TechnologyWith AAC, SBC, Qualcomm® aptX™, aptX HD, and aptX Low Latency codecsThe Monoprice™ Bluetooth® Long Range Transmitter and Receiver allows you to turn any audio device into a Bluetooth®‑enabled device. It uses a Bluetooth® 5 connection and features the AAC, SBC, Qualcomm® aptX™, aptX HD, and aptX Low Latency audio codecs for crystal clear audio streaming and synchronized audio for video transmissions.This single adapter can be used as a receiver or a transmitter. When used as a receiver, you can pair it with your phone or other audio source and stream audio to an audio system that otherwise lacks a Bluetooth® connection. When used as a transmitter, you can connect it to your audio system to stream audio to Bluetooth® headphones or speakers.The Multipoint Connection feature allows you to transmit to two audio playback devices at the same time or to connect two audio source devices to allow for seamless switching between audio sources. It includes both analog 3.5mm and digital optical S/PDIF wired connections for greater flexibility and higher quality audio. The built‑in rechargeable battery can deliver up to 25 hours of audio playback. LEDs indicate the operating mode, active audio codec, and the connected devices.Bluetooth® Transmitter and ReceiverTransmits or receives at up to 32 feet (10 meters) distanceAAC, SBC, Qualcomm® aptX™, aptX HD, and aptX Low Latency audio codecsSupports analog and digital optical audio connectionsMultipoint Connections for both the transmitter and receiverUp to 25 hours of audio playback BLUETOOTH® FOR ANY DEVICEThe Monoprice™ Bluetooth® Long Range Transmitter and Receiver allows you to turn any audio device into a Bluetooth®‑enabled device. Connect it to your home audio system as a receiver to stream audio from your phone or connect it to your home audio system as a transmitter to stream audio to Bluetooth® headphones or external speakers. LONG DISTANCE CONNECTIONSThe Bluetooth® radio features a transmission or reception distance of up to 32 feet (10 meters), giving you the freedom to move around without being tethered by wires. CD QUALITY SOUNDThe Monoprice™ Bluetooth® Long Range Transmitter and Receiver features a range of high‑quality audio codecs for the best sound possible. It includes the standard AAC and SBC codecs, as well as the more advanced Qualcomm® aptX™, Qualcomm aptX HD, and Qualcomm aptX Low Latency codecs. SYNCHRONIZED AUDIO AND VIDEOThe Qualcomm® aptX™ Low Latency codec removes any possible lag from the audio, ensuring that the audio is perfectly synchronized with your movies and games. STREAM AUDIO TO YOUR MAIN SYSTEMWhile Bluetooth® headphones and speakers can produce excellent quality sound, nothing can beat the quality offered by your home audio system. When used as a receiver, you can stream audio from your phone to your home system for the best quality sound. MULTIPOINT CONNECTIONSThe Monoprice™ Bluetooth® Long Range Transmitter and Receiver allows you to connect up to two devices at the same time. Pair with two Bluetooth® headphones, so you and a friend can listen at the same time.
